title: TenderMatch manufacturer claim provenance record
description: Schema for claim-level provenance mapping specific products, capabilities, and service claims to official source locators and validation states.

claim_id.description: Unique identifier for the claim (e.g., KORVUS-PVD-001).

manufacturer_id.description: Unique identifier of the manufacturer profile.

claim_term.description: The normalized product or keyword term associated with the claim.

source_url.description: Direct official URL from the manufacturer's verified source links.

source_locator.description: Section, heading, or page locator within the source document.

supporting_quote.description: Verbatim quote from official documentation substantiating the claim.
